scope: General binary64 full-significand multiplication/division on RP2040 Cortex-M0+. Cortex-M4 and portable M0 implementation unchanged.

implementation.multiply: Pack sign and exponent through modular subtraction while unpacking both 53-bit significands (11 rather than 15 instructions). Reuse the input exponent bound instead of two constant loads. Move slow/short-operand helpers out of the full-product fall-through path. Normalize products below two by clearing the implicit bit instead of loading/subtracting an exponent unit. All 106 product bits and nearest-even/sticky handling retained.
implementation.divide: Move slow/seed paths out of the general path, reuse exponent guard constants, pack metadata in fewer instructions, and prepare x1/y0 while SIO computes the reciprocal seed. Reciprocal/refinement/exact-remainder rounding algorithms retained.
implementation.sio_latency: Nine independent Thumb-1 ALU instructions after DIV_UDIVISOR before DIV_QUOTIENT. The ARM model checks at least eight. DIRTY divider state remains untouched via the software fallback.
implementation.ieee: No accuracy reduction. Full IEEE fallback remains for subnormals, NaNs, infinities and exponent extremes. Nearest-even and signed zero retained.
implementation.license: Existing BSD-3-Clause Pico SDK foundation and project modifications. GPL-2.0 Qfplib remains an external comparison only, never included in the firmware.

unchanged_addition_vs_baseline.scope: Read-only byte comparison: subtraction entry and all addition fast paths in the production ELF exactly match the independently tested ARM binary. No ELF execution or external fallback relocation check is performed.

production_addition_bytes.scope: Read-only byte comparison: subtraction entry and all addition fast paths in the production ELF exactly match the independently tested ARM binary. No ELF execution or external fallback relocation check is performed.

frozen_firmware_source_isolation.scope: Same frozen full-firmware source tree as previous acceptance; only RP2040 assembly changed.

full_significand_corpus.description: Six streams of 32 pairs for each operation, all operand significands odd and therefore needing all 53 significant bits. Includes both signs, mantissa product/ratio normalization branches, low-word boundaries, broad normal exponents and near-midpoint results. Every implementation checks exact host binary64 results.

near_midpoint_generation.rng: Python Random; two getrandbits(52)|1 per pair, plus the implicit bit
near_midpoint_generation.ranking: Smallest exact rational ULP distances to a midpoint; no floating-point ranking.

hardware.reason: No PicoCalc USB serial port was present. The user explicitly asked to continue without the device. No new physical timings or physical acceptance are claimed.
hardware.requires: Existing RP2040 125 MHz compiler-runtime resident firmware for the GCC control; local OWN/BASE/QFP/MATHLOCAL APPs use SRAM with zero resident arithmetic imports.
hardware.measurement_method: RP2040 TIMERAWL, median of nine paired 1024-call series minus identity; interrupts enabled. UID/state assertions, exclusive serial ownership, temporary test directory and unchanged calculator state checks remain in the HIL harness.

acceptance_limit: ARM functional qualification and instruction/memory traces passed. Instructions, taken transfers, MUL counts and memory-word accesses do not establish RP2040 cycles, microseconds, or a physical speed ordering against Qfplib. Hardware speed acceptance is still pending.
